_read_me: Merge the mcpServers entries below into your Claude Desktop config by hand (Settings > Developer > Edit Config).
This file is a snippet: nothing edits the real Desktop config for you.
Pick ONE openmontage entry: '-local' when the repo is on the same computer as Claude Desktop (replace /PATH/TO/openmontage),
'-over-ssh' when Claude Desktop runs on the Mac and the studio lives on abood (needs key-based ssh to the host alias 'abood').
Image and video generation use the Runway connector you already have in Claude Desktop; do not add any other image generator.
